scripts.build: BANNER=$(cat scripts/esbuild-banner.js) && ESBUILD_FLAGS="--bundle --keep-names --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm" && esbuild src/index.ts $ESBUILD_FLAGS "--banner:js=$BANNER" --outfile=dist/index.js && esbuild src/infrastructure/persistence/drizzle/migrate.ts $ESBUILD_FLAGS "--banner:js=$BANNER" --outfile=dist/migrate.js && esbuild src/infrastructure/db/seed.ts $ESBUILD_FLAGS "--banner:js=$BANNER" --outfile=dist/seed.js
scripts.test:s3: vitest run --config vitest.config.ts test/s3-auth.test.ts test/s3-auth-edge.test.ts test/s3-operations.test.ts test/s3-routing.test.ts test/s3-range.test.ts test/s3-object-stream.test.ts test/object-stream-parallel.test.ts test/s3-helpers-edge.test.ts test/s3-bucket-config.test.ts test/web-api.test.ts
